translation: Took place in posad Serock, 23 March 1890, 5 PM. Appeared personally Szymel[?] Markus, shoemaker, 34, and Alter Blumberg, trader, 22, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that yesterday at 5 AM in posad Serock died Frajda Ruchla Partowicz nee Roszkowicz[?], daughter of Judka and Chana nee Lejdkowicz[?], aged 24 years. She left behind her husband Motel[?] and son Abram. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of Partowicz, this act was read to the witnesses and signed by us and one witness.
